title: Meeting Edward Teller before his Los Alamos lecture
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Meeting Edward Teller before his Los Alamos lecture, about 1982 at Los Alamos, New Mexico, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Los Alamos National Laboratory, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Well, while working at Los Alamos National Lab in 1982, the local newspaper did a front page story on a jet car I had built. Coincidentally, Dr. Edward Teller was giving a speech at Los Alamos that same day.
